all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the Lord your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
Joel 2:13
Quote of the Day
"May we testify of [Jesus Christ] by the way we live and what we love."
Elder Ronald A. Rasband | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
